title: Volvo FM FUPS Hi-tensile Road Train Bullbar #28
description: Volvo heavy duty FUPS high tensile road train aluminium Bullbar. Custom built with heavy duty mesh and additional centre mounted small uprights for maximum cab protection. Custom driving light mounts can be fitted to customer specification. heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow provision for factory fitted radar. Insert photo shows additional forward projection of the uprights for maximum cab protection. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs. Indicator repeater and daylight running lights fitted to outer boxed uprights.
